target_customer: Industrial CO2 emitters and synthetic fuel and chemical buyers needing methanol
problem: Industrial CO2 emissions have little economic use, and e-methanol costs more than fossil methanol.
business_model: Chemicals producer selling clean methanol made from captured industrial CO2 (details not public)
product_category: CO2 to methanol clean fuel production

founders.name: Edgar Pavlovsky
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; he also posted a separate YC launch for Pentagon.

competitors.name: Oxylus Energy
competitors.what: Yale spinout converting captured CO2 to methanol electrochemically

competitors.name: Aerleum
competitors.what: Single step CO2 capture and conversion to methanol
competitors.traction_then: tests with up to 15 percent CO2 streams

competitors.name: European Energy Kasso plant
competitors.what: Commercial e-methanol from biogenic CO2 and green hydrogen, up to 42,000 tons a year
competitors.traction_then: supplies Maersk, LEGO and Novo Nordisk

technical_complexity.rationale: Chemical process development and plant scale up for CO2 conversion is hardware and chemistry heavy; founders list no chemistry background in the sources opened.

defensibility.rationale: No proprietary process is described; several funded teams and commercial plants already exist.

market_need_then: E-methanol is promoted for shipping decarbonization, but sources note it remains much costlier than fossil methanol due to electricity costs.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; search for the name returned nothing and the name is easily confused with Aerleum.

outcome_analysis: Aernata is a Spring 2026 YC company with two repeat founders from finance and crypto backgrounds aiming to make methanol from industrial CO2. Little public information exists. Competing efforts have more funding and operating plants, and e-methanol cost remains the central risk; no outcome is known yet.
notes: No news or funding found for Aernata in two searches; results returned Aerleum and Oxylus, which are different companies. Competitor entries are dated 2024 to 2025 and show the field as of founding. Founding year not stated in sources (YC listing implies 2026) so left null. Founder education not listed.
